title: 'Anti-people': Karnataka BJP stages protest against Congress over price hikes including milk

ai.summary: Karnataka BJP staged a protest against Congress government over price hikes including milk, with former chief ministers claiming over Rs 1 lakh crore in new taxes and a four lakh crore loan have been imposed on residents.

facts.claim: Karnataka BJP staged a protest against Congress government over price hikes including milk
facts.quote: The Bharatiya Janata Party's Karnataka unit staged a protest against Congress government on Wednesday criticising the recent price hikes, including that of milk in the state.

facts.claim: Former Karnataka chief minister Basavaraj Bommai claimed that over Rs 1 lakh crore in new taxes had been levied on the people of Karnataka
facts.quote: Former Karnataka chief minister Basavaraj Bommai claimed that over Rs 1 lakh crore in new taxes had been levied on the people of Karnataka.

facts.claim: Former chief minister and BJP leader BS Yediyurappa joined the protest, criticising the price hikes
facts.quote: Former chief minister and BJP leader BS Yediyurappa joined the protest, criticising the price hikes and highlighting the burden they have placed on the public.

facts.claim: The protest was led by BJP state president B Y Vijayendra, leader of opposition in the legislative assembly R Ashoka and leader of opposition in the legislative council Chalavadi Narayanaswamy
facts.quote: The protest was led by BJP state president B Y Vijayendra, leader of opposition in the legislative assembly R Ashoka and leader of opposition in the legislative council Chalavadi Narayanaswamy.

facts.claim: The protesters accused the state government, led by D K Shivakumar, of burdening ordinary people with successive price increases and described it as an "anti-people government"
facts.quote: The protesters accused the state government, led by D K Shivakumar, of burdening ordinary people with successive price increases and described it as an "anti-people government".

ai.background_note: Karnataka BJP protests against Congress government over price hikes, with former chief ministers citing significant tax burdens and loan amounts.
